cases.translation: A laboratory dog approximately two years old.
cases.explain: «Собака» is the subject of the clinical description, so it stands in the Nominative case.

cases.sentence: Отныне загадочная функция ___ – мозгового придатка – разъяснена.
cases.translation: From now on, the mysterious function of the pituitary gland — the brain appendage — has been explained.
cases.explain: «Функция (чего?) гипофиза» — possession/relation is expressed by the Genitive, so гипофиз becomes гипофиза.

cases.sentence: Теперь, проходя по ___, я с тайным ужасом смотрю на встречных псов.
cases.translation: Now, walking along the street, I look at the dogs I pass with secret dread.
cases.explain: The preposition «по» meaning "along" governs the Dative case, so улица becomes улице.

cases.sentence: Скальпель хирурга вызвал к жизни новую человеческую ___.
cases.translation: The surgeon's scalpel brought a new human unit/individual to life.
cases.explain: The transitive verb «вызвал» (brought/called into being) takes a direct object in the Accusative, so единица becomes единицу.

cases.sentence: Записи он вел то карандашом, то фиолетовыми ___.
cases.translation: He kept his notes sometimes in pencil, sometimes in violet ink.
cases.explain: The instrument used for writing is expressed by the Instrumental case, so чернила becomes чернилами.

cases.sentence: Шерсть осталась только на ___, на подбородке и на груди.
cases.translation: Fur remained only on the head, the chin, and the chest.
cases.explain: The preposition «на» expressing location governs the Prepositional case, so голова becomes голове.

reading.ru: Лабораторная собака примерно двух лет от роду.
reading.question: How does Bormenthal's diary describe Sharik at the very start of the case history?
options: As a laboratory dog approximately two years old
As a puppy only a few months old
reading.correct: As a laboratory dog approximately two years old
reading.explain: The case history opens by describing the subject as a laboratory dog of about two years of age, breed mongrel, named Sharik.

reading.ru: В 8.30 часов вечера произведена первая в Европе операция по профессору Преображенскому.
reading.question: What is claimed about the operation performed at 8:30 in the evening?
options: That it was the first of its kind performed in Europe, by Professor Preobrazhensky's method
That it was a routine, minor procedure
That it was performed by a different doctor
reading.correct: That it was the first of its kind performed in Europe, by Professor Preobrazhensky's method
reading.explain: The diary records that at 8:30 pm the first operation of its kind in Europe was performed using Professor Preobrazhensky's method.

reading.ru: В ночь после операции Грозные повторные падения пульса.
reading.question: What complication is recorded on the night after the operation?
reading.correct: Repeated, alarming drops in pulse
reading.explain: The record for that night notes ominous, repeated drops in the pulse and expectation of a fatal outcome.

reading.ru: Пульс еле прощупывается, похолодание конечностей, зрачки не реагируют.
reading.question: What worrying signs does the entry for December 25th record?
options: A barely detectable pulse, cold extremities, and unresponsive pupils
A strong, steady pulse and normal temperature
reading.correct: A barely detectable pulse, cold extremities, and unresponsive pupils
reading.explain: The entry describes a barely perceptible pulse, cold limbs, and pupils that no longer react — signs of near-death.

reading.ru: Внезапно обнаружено выпадение шерсти на лбу и на боках туловища.
reading.question: What unexpected symptom is discovered on December 29th?
options: Sudden fur loss on the forehead and sides of the body
reading.correct: Sudden fur loss on the forehead and sides of the body
reading.explain: On December 29th, Bormenthal notes sudden hair loss discovered on the forehead and the sides of the body.

reading.ru: Выпадение шерсти приняло характер общего облысения.
reading.question: How does the fur loss progress by December 30th?
options: It stops completely and fur regrows
reading.correct: It develops into general baldness
reading.explain: By December 30th, the hair loss has taken on the character of general baldness across the whole body.

reading.ru: В 12 часов 12 минут дня пёс отчётливо пролаял «Аб-быр».
reading.question: What happens at 12:12 pm on December 31st?
options: The dog distinctly barks out the sound 'Ab-byr'
The dog completely stops making sounds
The dog runs away from the apartment
reading.correct: The dog distinctly barks out the sound 'Ab-byr'
reading.explain: At 12:12 in the afternoon, the dog distinctly barks out the syllables 'Ab-byr' for the first time.

reading.ru: Профессор расшифровал слово «Абырвалг».
reading.question: What does the professor eventually decode the repeated word 'Abyrvalg' to mean?
reading.correct: 'Glavryba' (Main Fish, a sign read backwards)
reading.explain: The professor deciphers 'Abyrvalg' as 'Главрыба' (Main Fish Trust) read backward, a sign the dog once tried to read.

reading.ru: В 1 час 13 минут глубокий обморок с профессором Преображенским.
reading.question: What happens to Professor Preobrazhensky himself at 1:13, when the creature laughs?
options: He suffers a deep fainting spell
He bursts into laughter as well
reading.correct: He suffers a deep fainting spell
reading.explain: The startling entry notes that at 1:13 Professor Preobrazhensky himself had a deep fainting spell, hitting his head on a chair leg as he fell.

reading.ru: Начиная с пяти часов дня, из смотровой, где расхаживает это существо, слышится явственно вульгарная ругань и слова «еще парочку».
reading.question: What can be heard from the examination room starting at five in the afternoon?
options: Clearly audible vulgar cursing and phrases like 'another pair'
reading.correct: Clearly audible vulgar cursing and phrases like 'another pair'
reading.explain: From five o'clock on, vulgar swearing and phrases such as 'another pair' can be clearly heard from the examination room where the creature paces.

reading.ru: Череп увеличился значительно, лоб скошен и низок.
reading.question: How has the creature's skull changed by January 7th?
options: It has grown significantly larger, with a sloped, low forehead
It shows no change at all
reading.correct: It has grown significantly larger, with a sloped, low forehead
reading.explain: The entry notes the skull has enlarged considerably, and the forehead is sloped and low.

reading.ru: В утренних газетах появилась удивительная заметка.
reading.question: What appears in the morning papers regarding the strange rumors?
options: A surprising note denying rumors of a Martian and blaming traders for spreading them
A full scientific explanation of the professor's experiment
An arrest warrant for Filipp Filippovich
Nothing related to the case at all
reading.correct: A surprising note denying rumors of a Martian and blaming traders for spreading them
reading.explain: A strange note in the morning papers denies rumors of a Martian in the Obukhov lane, blaming traders from Sukharevka for spreading them.

reading.ru: Профессор Преображенский, делавший кесарево сечение у матери.
reading.question: What absurd claim does the evening newspaper make about Professor Preobrazhensky?
options: That he performed a caesarean section on the mother of a violin-playing baby
That he was arrested for fraud
That he discovered a cure for baldness
reading.correct: That he performed a caesarean section on the mother of a violin-playing baby
reading.explain: The evening paper runs an absurd story about a baby born who plays the violin, captioned with Professor Preobrazhensky as the one who performed the caesarean on the mother.

reading.ru: Филипп Филиппович, как истый ученый, признал свою ошибку.
reading.question: How does Filipp Filippovich react once he reaches his diagnosis on January 8th?
options: As a true scientist, he admits his mistake
He refuses to accept any error
He blames Bormenthal for the outcome
reading.correct: As a true scientist, he admits his mistake
reading.explain: Being a true scientist, Filipp Filippovich openly admits his error once the real diagnosis becomes clear.

reading.ru: Перемена гипофиза дает не омоложение, а полное очеловечение, подчеркнуто три раза.
reading.question: What is the corrected diagnosis about what the pituitary transplant actually causes?
reading.correct: Complete humanization, not rejuvenation
reading.explain: The diagnosis, underlined three times, states that changing the pituitary gland causes not rejuvenation but complete humanization.

reading.ru: Затем он почесал затылок, огляделся, и я записал новое, отчетливо произнесенное слово «буржуи».
reading.question: What new word does Bormenthal record the creature saying after scratching its head and looking around?
reading.correct: 'Bourgeois' (буржуи)
reading.explain: After scratching the back of his head and looking around, the creature clearly utters the new word 'bourgeois,' which Bormenthal records.

reading.ru: Напевая по своему обыкновению, он спросил, «Что же мы теперь будем делать?» И сам же ответил буквально так, «Москва-Швея, да, от Севильи до Гренады.
reading.question: How does Filipp Filippovich react when Bormenthal finds him uncertain about what to do next?
options: He hums as usual, asks what they'll do now, then answers himself with a nonsensical mix of phrases
He confidently lays out a clear plan immediately
He refuses to discuss the matter
He orders Sharikov out of the apartment
reading.correct: He hums as usual, asks what they'll do now, then answers himself with a nonsensical mix of phrases
reading.explain: Humming as usual, he asks what they should do now, then answers himself with a jumble of unrelated phrases, showing his uncharacteristic confusion.

reading.ru: «Дай папиросочку, у тебя брюки в полосочку».
reading.question: What rhyming phrase does the creature say on January 11th?
options: 'Give me a cigarette, your trousers have a little stripe'
reading.correct: 'Give me a cigarette, your trousers have a little stripe'
reading.explain: On January 11th he produces a cheerful rhyming phrase about wanting a cigarette and noticing striped trousers.

reading.ru: Именно, когда профессор приказал ему «не бросай объедки на пол», неожиданно ответил «отлезь, гнида».
reading.question: What is significant about the creature's first reactive words, according to Bormenthal?
options: When told not to throw scraps on the floor, he retorts rudely, showing the words were a genuine reaction, not random noise
He simply repeats whatever is said to him
He stays completely silent when addressed
He apologizes politely for the first time
reading.correct: When told not to throw scraps on the floor, he retorts rudely, showing the words were a genuine reaction, not random noise
reading.explain: When the professor tells him not to throw scraps on the floor, he snaps back rudely — the first time his words are a direct reaction to what is said to him.

reading.ru: Изумительный опыт профессора Преображенского раскрыл одну из тайн человеческого мозга.
reading.question: What grand claim does Bormenthal make about the significance of the professor's experiment?
options: That it revealed one of the secrets of the human brain
That it was ultimately a failure
reading.correct: That it revealed one of the secrets of the human brain
reading.explain: Bormenthal excitedly writes that the professor's astonishing experiment has uncovered one of the secrets of the human brain.

reading.ru: Профессор Преображенский, вы творец.
reading.question: How does Bormenthal address the professor in his enthusiastic reflection?
reading.correct: As a creator
reading.explain: Carried away, Bormenthal calls the professor a 'creator' for having brought a new human being into existence via the scalpel.

reading.ru: Семь сухаревских торговцев уже сидят за распространение слухов о свето-представлении, которое навлекли большевики.
reading.question: What has happened to seven Sukharevka traders, according to the diary?
options: They have been arrested/detained for spreading rumors about a coming apocalypse blamed on the Bolsheviks
reading.correct: They have been arrested/detained for spreading rumors about a coming apocalypse blamed on the Bolsheviks
reading.explain: The entry notes seven Sukharevka traders are already being held for spreading rumors that the Bolsheviks caused a coming cosmic catastrophe.

reading.ru: Клим Григорьевич Чугункин, 25 лет, холост.
reading.question: Who is Klim Grigoryevich Chugunkin, as introduced in the inserted case file?
options: The 25-year-old, unmarried man whose pituitary gland was used in the operation
Sharikov's original owner before he became a stray
reading.correct: The 25-year-old, unmarried man whose pituitary gland was used in the operation
reading.explain: Chugunkin is introduced as the 25-year-old, unmarried donor whose pituitary gland was transplanted into Sharik.

reading.ru: Причина смерти – удар ножом в сердце, в пивной.
reading.question: What was Chugunkin's cause of death?
options: A knife wound to the heart, in a tavern
reading.correct: A knife wound to the heart, in a tavern
reading.explain: Chugunkin's file records his cause of death as a knife blow to the heart, received in a tavern.

reading.ru: Перед нами новый организм.
reading.question: How does Bormenthal characterize the final result at the very end of the case history?
options: As a completely new organism that must be observed from the beginning
As a complete failure with no scientific value
As identical to an ordinary dog
reading.correct: As a completely new organism that must be observed from the beginning
reading.explain: Bormenthal closes the case history stating that before them is a new organism, which must be studied from scratch.

highlight.question: Which sentence reveals the shocking behavior the transformed creature displayed in the professor's presence?
sentences: Русская наука чуть не понесла тяжёлую утрату.
История болезни профессора Ф. Ф. Преображенского.
В 1 час 13 мин. – глубокий обморок с проф. Преображенским. При падении ударился головой о палку стула. Т-а.
В моём и Зины присутствии пёс (если псом, конечно, можно назвать) обругал проф. Преображенского по матери.
highlight.explain: The dog cursed Professor Preobrazhensky using profanity, demonstrating an unexpected capacity for human language and aggression.
